signal: Dealerslink launched its 2026 AI Suite and set a record with 1,400+ dealers visiting its NADA 2026 booth

email.body1:
Eric, saw Dealerslink launched its 2026 AI Suite and drew a record 1,400-plus dealers at NADA.

Demand spikes like that surface more in-market dealerships than a regional team can work before they cool, and that is where pipeline slips. Our AI SDR researches, writes, and follows up autonomously, so coverage scales without new headcount: 3-5x more meetings per rep.

I built a personalized signal play for Dealerslink off your hiring and tech-stack signals, and accounts showing them tend to progress about 4.4x faster. Worth 15 minutes for me to walk you through it?
email.body2:
Eric, quick follow-up for Dealerslink.

A record show and new AI suite drive dealer interest fast, but most teams cannot say how many meetings they need to convert that into signed deals this quarter. The gap shows up late, mid-quarter.

Want to grab 15 minutes? I will walk you through our pipeline model and show exactly how many meetings Dealerslink needs to hit target, and where it breaks if you only add reps.
email.body3:
Eric, last bit of proof for Dealerslink.

Memgraph had more in-market accounts than the team could touch and could not hire SDRs fast enough. They ran our AI SDR to $2.7M in pipeline, 600 replies, and 60 BANT-qualified deals in 90 days, same team, live in four weeks, every email auto-logged to CRM.

I pulled a benchmark of how Dealerslink's reply rate likely compares to other automotive-tech teams. Want to hop on a quick call and I will walk you through it?
email.body4:
Eric, I will stop reaching out on this one, but did not want to leave you empty-handed.

If scaling dealer pipeline without adding headcount is not a priority this quarter, no problem at all. Following up on a record NADA is its own kind of busy.

Before I close your file, worth 15 minutes to walk through a one-page playbook of three AI-SDR plays scoped to an automotive sales motion? I will tailor it to Dealerslink either way.
